summary: Sealed park car park beside playground; nearest homes across the access road.
reasons: Homes over 30 m from north side

best_section.where: North edge of the car park, nearest the playground

drivers.seclusion: North edge backs onto park lawn and trees. Nearest dwelling (15 m) is at the south-west corner, across the access road; school buildings 40 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Mapped asphalt car park with an entrance from the south road. Several cars parked, room for a van. No gate seen.
drivers.traffic: Busy road about 60 m east, screened by trees. Quiet in the car park.
drivers.convention: Public car park serving a playground and court; cars park there by day.
